<script>
    if (typeof window === 'object') {

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

            const button = document.getElementById('toggleMainMenu');

            button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                // Mega menu
                const menu = document.getElementById('megaMenu');
                menu.classList.toggle('hidden');

                // Check if menu.classList contains hidden and "hide" the main button row
                const headerButtonRow = document.getElementById('headerbuttonrow');
                if (menu.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                    headerButtonRow.classList.remove('translate-y-[50px]');
                    // Set tabindex to default state
                    headerButtonRow.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((link) => {
                        link.setAttribute('tabindex', 0);
                    });
                } else {
                    headerButtonRow.classList.add('translate-y-[50px]');
                    // Set tabindex to -1
                    headerButtonRow.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((link) => {
                        link.setAttribute('tabindex', -1);
                    });
                    
                }

                // Toggle icon and text
                button.classList.toggle('menubutton--state__open');
                button.classList.toggle('menubutton--state__close');

                // Change aria-state
                const ariaExpandedValue = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded');
                button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', ariaExpandedValue === 'false' ? true : false);
            })

            document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                const menu = document.getElementById('megaMenu');
                const localMenu = document.getElementById('localMenu');
                const openButton = document.getElementById('toggleMainMenu');
                if (!menu.contains(event.target) && !localMenu?.contains(event.target) && !openButton.contains(event.target)) {
                    closeMenu();
                }
            });

            // Add event listener to check if <main> has tab focus
            const main = document.querySelector('#main');
            main.addEventListener('focusin', () => {
                closeMenu();
            });

            function closeMenu() {

                const menu = document.getElementById('megaMenu');
                if (!menu.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                    menu.classList.add('hidden');
                }

                // Check if menu.classList contains hidden and "hide" the main button row
                const headerButtonRow = document.getElementById('headerbuttonrow');
                if (menu.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                    headerButtonRow.classList.remove('translate-y-[50px]');
                }

                // Change icon and text
                if (button.classList.contains('menubutton--state__close')) { 
                    button.classList.remove('menubutton--state__close');
                    button.classList.add('menubutton--state__open');
                }
                
                // Change aria-state
                const ariaExpandedValue = button.getAttribute('aria-expanded');
                if (ariaExpandedValue === 'true') {
                    button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
                }
            }
        });
    }
</script>

            <h1 class="header mb-5 lg:mb-7" >Welcome to Haukeliseter Mountain Lodge</h1>
            <p class="text-xl mb-5 lg:mb-7">In the mountains. By the roadside. Always open!</p>

        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Top block area -->
    


    


    <!-- Main body -->
    <div class="container mb-10 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-x-7">
            <div class="col-span-narrow mt-5 md:mt-10 body-area">
                


<p>Haukeliseter Mountain Lodge is centrally located along the E134 at Haukelifjell, 1000 meters above sea level. The Mountain Lodge is the gateway to Hardangervidda National Park in the north, and Ryfylkeheiene and Setesdalsheiene in the south.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The opportunities for activities at Haukeliseter are many; hiking, alpine, -randonn&eacute;e and -cross-country skiing, snow kiting, dog sledding, kayaking and canoeing, hunting and fishing, and relaxing in the lavvo or the outdoor spa.</p>
<p>Besides the spectacular view and nature, the food in the resturant is a good reason to visit us. We serve traditional, Norwegian food with a focus on local ingredients. We also have our very own bakery. Daily you can buy buns, bread, and other delicious baked goods.</p>
<p><a title="Haukeliseter live - go to webcam" href="http://94.139.67.154:50000/axis-cgi/jpg/image.cgi?resolution=800x500">Haukeliseter live - go to webcam</a></p>
<h2><img class="fotoware-img" src="/globalassets/fotoware/2023/11/dji_0049_4.jpg#1738146684027&amp;width=810" alt="Haukeliseter fjellstue i flyfoto i overgangen h&oslash;st til vinter, det ligger et lite lag med sn&oslash; p&aring; fjellene og fjellstuen" width="640" height="480" /></h2>
<h2>Opening hours</h2>
<p>Haukeliseter Mountain Lodge is always open - every day, all year round.</p>
<p>The reception is open from 8 am until 9.30 pm every day.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We serve food in the restaurant from 12 am until 8 pm on Sunday to Thursday, and until 9 pm on Friday and Saturday (until 9 pm every day during the high season).</p>
<h2>Accommodation</h2>
<p>Haukeliseter offers rooms in a variety of price ranges, with different facilities and standards.&nbsp;<a title="Please go to online booking" href="https://hyttebestilling.dnt.no/hytte/10660?_ga=2.223342555.1760736135.1684742880-540962070.1666610876">Please go to online booking</a>, and read more under the descriptions of each room standard.&nbsp;</p>
<p><a title="Overview of prices" href="/contentassets/f270832a2a35456daa19864ad6e699bc/priser-2026---engelsk.pdf">Overview of prices</a><br /><a href="/hytter/betjente/haukeliseter/english/cancellation-terms-haukeliseter/">Go to cancellation terms</a></p>
<h2>Restaurant</h2>
<h4>Breakfast</h4>
<p>At Haukeliseter we offer a breakfast buffet consisting of freshly baked bread, local ingredients, and other favourites such as eggs, cereal and oatmeal.</p>
<h4>Mountain menu</h4>
<p>The mountain menu is our &agrave; la carte menu and consists of several different dishes, including vegetarian options. Our guests especially appreciate our homemade meatballs, sour cream porridge and soup of the day which are served as a buffet; eat as much as you like.</p>
<p>Our Moutain Menu with prices:</p>
<p><img src="/contentassets/f270832a2a35456daa19864ad6e699bc/fjellmeny-vinter-2026_2027-engelsk.jpg?width=810" alt="" width="1820" height="2561" /></p>
<h4>Three course dinner</h4>
<p>The three course dinner is served every Friday and Saturday evening throughout the year. During high season, three course dinner is served several times a week. Must be pre-ordered due to limited capacity.&nbsp;</p>
<h2>Contact us</h2>
<p>Visiting address: Haukelivegen 2917, 3895 Edland<br />Phone: +47 3506 2777<br />E-mail: haukeliseter@dnt.no&nbsp;<br />Facebook: Haukeliseter fjellstue</p>
            </div>
    </div>
